desc.en: Mysterious cloth that has a feeling of divine power. This ultimate cloth repels fire and water, while not allowing cold or wind to pass through. It's difficult to process, and there are few who can work with it.
desc.ja: 神秘の力を感じられる不思議な布。炎や水を弾き、冷気や風を通さない究極の布地。加工が難しく、扱える技術を持った者は少ない

desc.en: Effect: Selecting this property increases the item's effect power by 20％.
desc.ja: 効果：調合の潜力選択時に選択すると、アイテムの効力を２０％上昇させる

desc.en: Causes armor to increase maximum MP. Effect: Maximum MP increases by 15.
desc.ja: 防具に最大ＭＰを上昇させる効果を付与する。効果：最大ＭＰが１５上昇する

desc.en: Effect: Increases defense and speed by 10.
desc.ja: 効果：防御力・素早さが１０上昇する
